title: The Iron Lantern
author: Zephyrine Delacroix
blurb: Freya Crane, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
